items.information:
Yarışda hər kəs iştirak edə bilər. BMU tələbələri üçün xüsusi endirim var!
Everyone is welcome in this competition. There is special discount for BEU students!

items.name: Desafio de Verão 2018
items.information:
Taxa de inscrição: **R$10,00** (a ser paga ao delegado no dia e no local do campeonato). **`ATENÇÃO: ao se inscrever, favor informar no campo de comentários a cidade na qual irá participar!`**

A competição contará **apenas** com a modalidade **3x3 em menos movimentos**. Para saber mais informações sobre as regras dessa modalidade, [clique aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/#article-E-fewest-moves).

items.name: Dongguan Open 2018

venue.name: SSL Academic Communication Center
venue.address: Hongmian Rd, Technological and Industrial Park

items.information:
The limitation is 170 participants, based on a first-come-first-serve rule.
For Chinese domestic participants, a completed registration is automatically done based on online registration plus prepaid registration fee. 
For oversea participants, if you can't pay the fee online via Alipay, pls contact the delegate. Then we will make a reservation for you by manually accepting your registration and you can pay the fee by cash at the venue. Please check the competition website for registration and the other information.

items.name: Cult A Way Cube Open 2018

venue.name: Sree Chitra Thirunal College of Engineering
venue.address: Sree Chitra Thirunal College of Engineering, CTO Colony, Pappanamcode, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695018

items.information:
Participation limit is 50, so register as soon as possible.
Registrations closes on 28th February 23:59 IST. Refer the [Registration & Payment tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CultAWayCubeOpen2018#3973-registration-payment) to get the details on how to register.
